findings.finding: The resale S-1/A for up to 7.5M further Yorkville conversion shares (filed 2026-09-24, not yet effective per EDGAR submissions as of the screen) can be declared effective overnight or during 2026-10-01. findings.mechanism_in_window: This issuer's previous resale S-1 went from filing (2026-07-08) to EFFECT plus 424B3 (2026-07-10) in two days. The current amendment has been on file for 4 sessions, so effectiveness is a live possibility on any given night, including this one. The registered 5.4M-share capacity was already fully issued by 2026-09-23, which is why a new registration is needed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Around the July resale effectiveness (EFFECT 2026-07-10) and the later conversions, the stock fell from the teens to $2.48 (60-day run-up -50.9%). Of this name's 12 comparable falls, 8 were followed by a lower next close (median -1.85%).
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall came with no filing and ordinary volume, so it reads as ongoing supply rather than a priced registration event. If the market already held effectiveness as certain tonight, the fall would have come on the heavier volume of a known supply date. As it stands, an EFFECT posting is a discrete, visible event the close does not contain.
